scripts.dev: bun run engine && bun run assets && vite
scripts.build: bun run engine && bun run assets && vite build
scripts.lint: oxlint src scripts/assets scripts/engine tests --ignore-pattern src/assets/generated && cd .. && frontend/node_modules/.bin/oxlint engine/build.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun run engine && bun run assets && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p scripts/assets/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && tsc -p scripts/engine/tsconfig.json
scripts.format: oxfmt --check src scripts/assets scripts/engine tests playwright.config.ts --ignore-path .prettierignore && cd .. && frontend/node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check engine/build.ts
scripts.format:write: oxfmt --write src scripts/assets scripts/engine tests playwright.config.ts --ignore-path .prettierignore && cd .. && frontend/node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --write engine/build.ts
